promptEs: ¿Cómo queda esta melodía si la transponés de Re mayor a La mayor?
explanationEs: La melodía D4 F#4 A4 D5 A4 F#4 en Re mayor se transporta a La mayor subiendo 7 semitonos: A4 C#5 E5 A5 E5 C#5.
promptEn: How does this melody sound if you transpose it from D major to A major?
explanationEn: D4 F#4 A4 D5 A4 F#4 in D major becomes A4 C#5 E5 A5 E5 C#5 in A major. The shape 1-3-5-8-5-3 is kept and every degree lands on the same scale degree in the new key.
